Clouding AI · Red Sea Global demo film · Production storyboard v1

From First Question to Personal Concierge

04:49.2 program (289.2 s) · 16:9 · 1920x1080 · 30 fps · 35 shots · narration 483 words, about 214 s at 140 wpm · English voice-over, no subtitles · built from three screen recordings and editor-made cards. Stills are from the recordings with the planned crops and masks applied.

Sources: Final version of the Agent.mp4, ERP to Concierge .mp4, Concierge to Customer.mp4. Every source time was checked frame by frame in Phase 1 (PHASE1_FOOTAGE_LOG.md). Program times are cumulative and reconcile to the runtime below.

Opening

Set the guest's problem before the product: a stay starts with questions, and the hosts need the answers too. Then introduce Rafiq on the Visit Red Sea page.

Chapter 1 · Planning the stay

Prove that the agent plans a priced stay in one conversation: it learns the guest's name and keeps using it, hands him to the page to choose a resort and picks the choice back up, works with taps, typing and voice, updates the total as he chooses, and ends on a review he can edit and a booking PDF. Nothing is paid or confirmed in the chat.
